quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
A T intersection is ahead.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or guide rail between them.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing it. When may you cross these lines?

options.text: Only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
To pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Never.
Only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may only cross them to turn left into or out of an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.
Construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Intersection ahead.
Steep downhill grade ahead.
Winding road ahead.
Merging traffic ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downhill grade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Drive carefully through the intersection.
Prepare to stop because the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and carefully. Look both ways to check for traffic before driving through.

questions.question: When parallel parking between two cars, what should you do first?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left.
Turn your wheels to the right.
Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
Back up slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull up even with the car in front of your desired parking space.
questions.explanation: First, stop parallel to the car in front of the empty space you want to use. Check traffic and signal your intention. Then turn your wheels to park.

questions.question: When may you cross double solid yellow lines?

options.text: To pass a slow-moving truck.
To turn into a driveway.
To pass another car.
Never.

questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid lines mean no passing or lane changes. You may only cross them to turn left into or out of a driveway or to make a U-turn where permitted.

questions.question: When entering a freeway, what should you do?

options.text: Go slowly while you wait for an opening.
Speed up faster than the traffic already on the freeway.
Turn on your hazard lights until you are safely on the freeway.
Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the freeway traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the on-ramp to accelerate to freeway speed so you can merge smoothly and safely. You must yield to traffic already on the freeway.

questions.question: What do pennant-shaped signs indicate?

options.text: School zones.
No passing zones.
Speed limits.
Railroad crossings.

questions.correctAnswerText: No passing zones.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs mark no passing zones. The sign will have words on it to confirm this.

questions.question: If you turn left onto a one-way street, which lane should you turn into?

options.text: The right lane.
The lane closest to your previous lane.
Either lane.
Neither lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: Always turn into the lane that is closest to the direction you came from. This is the safest turning practice.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass other traffic going the same direction.
During daylight hours only.
At any time.
When turning.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning.
questions.explanation: Broken lines can be crossed, but solid lines cannot. You may only cross a solid yellow line when you are turning.

questions.question: In Utah, what blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is illegal for driving?

options.text: 0.02 percent.
0.05 percent.
0.08 percent.
0.1 percent.

questions.correctAnswerText: 0.05 percent.
questions.explanation: In Utah, you cannot legally drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.05 percent or higher. Driving while impaired is also illegal, even if your BAC is below the legal limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled permits.
A circular intersection is ahead.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
Lanes are for buses and vehicles carrying multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What is the speed limit in a school zone during school hours?

options.text: 15 mph.
20 mph.
25 mph.
30 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: 20 mph.
questions.explanation: The speed limit in a school zone is 20 miles per hour during school hours, when children are present, or when warning lights are flashing.

questions.question: When should you leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped?

options.text: On a hill.
At an intersection.
At a stop sign.
At a toll plaza.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a hill.
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on an uphill slope. If the vehicle ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, extra space reduces the chance of a collision.

questions.question: What should you do if your car with anti-lock brakes starts to slip on a wet road?

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: If your car loses traction on a wet road, press down hard on the brake pedal, hold it, and steer to safety. Anti-lock brakes pump automatically faster than you can. Letting up on the brakes or pumping them yourself will turn off the anti-lock system.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an uncontrolled intersection at the same time, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The largest vehicle.
The car on the left.
The car on the right. The car on the left must yield.
The car on the left. The car on the right must yield.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the right. The car on the left must yield.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at the same time to an uncontrolled intersection, the driver on the left must yield to the driver on the right. The driver on the left can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when a traffic light turns yellow as you approach an intersection?

options.text: Treat it like a caution sign and drive through the intersection.
Stop right away.
Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive through carefully.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive through carefully.
questions.explanation: When a yellow light appears, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if it is safe to do so. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow mean?

options.text: It is never used on traffic signals.
It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
It means you can turn in the direction of the arrow.
It warns that a green arrow is coming next.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow circular light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: When there are two railroad tracks next to each other, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
Always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for another train before crossing.
questions.explanation: When there are two tracks, watch for a second train after the first one passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming on either track.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
They rarely use their headlights.
Motorcycle drivers are less skilled than other drivers.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are small and easy to miss. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge how far away a motorcycle is or how fast it is going. Always watch carefully around motorcycles.

questions.question: What should you do at an uncontrolled intersection?

options.text: Keep your speed and go.
Stop, look both ways, and then go.
Let all other drivers go first.
Be ready to yield if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to yield if needed.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no stop sign or traffic light, yield to cars coming from your right. Always be ready to yield. Ease off the gas, get ready to brake, and look left, right, and left again.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: You can pass from either direction.
You can pass from the side with the broken line.
You can pass from the side with the solid line.
No one can pass from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can pass from the side with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass only from the side next to the broken line.

questions.question: What must you do to pass on a two-lane road with traffic going both ways?

options.text: Do not cross the center line.
Flash your lights at oncoming cars.
Use the shoulder.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road, you must use the oncoming traffic lane to pass. Only pass if you can do so safely and legally.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their bright headlights. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the oncoming car.
At the right side of the road.
At the left side of the road.
Straight ahead down the middle.

questions.correctAnswerText: At the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: If an oncoming driver does not dim their bright lights, look to the right. This keeps you from getting blinded and lets you see the road so you can stay on course until the car passes.
